trumpRule: CODEX 48: Commitment is the contract between insurer and insured. Every Schedule exception must reference a real chain event. P0 defects block final commitment — no exceptions.

canvasTabs.label: Schedule A
canvasTabs.description: Title commitment Schedule A. Effective date. Policy amounts: Owner's Policy (promulgated TDI rate) + Lender's Policy (simultaneous = $100 flat per TX-T-003). Vesting (how title will be taken). Legal description of the property. Plat reference. Status: DRAFT / ISSUED / FINALIZED. Wet close notice (TX-T-005) displayed in yellow info band.

canvasTabs.label: Schedule B-1
canvasTabs.description: Requirements to be performed before policy is issued. Numbered list: each requirement is a card with status (Pending/Satisfied). Common: (1) seller must sign and deliver deed, (2) pay off existing mortgages, (3) pay taxes current, (4) pay closing costs, (5) wire fraud verification on any wire changes. Each requirement has a checkbox + note field. When all are Satisfied → SATISFIED banner. Direct link to Escrow Manager (re-escrow-001) for funds tracking.

canvasTabs.label: Schedule B-2
canvasTabs.description: Exceptions from coverage. Numbered exception list from chain-of-title bundle. Standard exceptions: taxes for current/prior years, survey exception (auto-added per TX-T-010 until survey received), restrictive covenants of record. Non-standard exceptions: open liens, easements, HOA restrictions. Each exception CAS-coded: GREEN (standard, waivable) / YELLOW (review) / RED (P0 defect — commitment blocked until cured). Survey exception badge: 'Survey exception will be removed when current survey received.'

canvasTabs.label: Rate Sheet
canvasTabs.description: TDI promulgated rate calculation. Property value input → Owner's Policy premium (from rate schedule) + simultaneous Lender's Policy ($100). Endorsement charges. Total premium. Rate schedule last-verified date (WARN if >365 days per TX-T-004). Footnote: 'Texas title insurance rates are set by the Texas Department of Insurance. No deviation is permitted.' Print rate sheet button.

canvasTabs.label: Status
canvasTabs.description: Order timeline: search complete → commitment draft → buyer review → requirements satisfied → final commitment issued → policy issued. Current step highlighted. P0 defect blocker: if any open P0 defects, RED banner 'Final commitment blocked: [N] P0 defects unresolved. Resolve in Defect Tracker.' Actions: Send commitment to buyer (triggers customer portal view), Send to Escrow Manager, Mark requirement satisfied. Signature request status if commitment sent for buyer acknowledgment.
